name: Basic NMOS Current Mirror
description: Two-transistor diode-connected reference current mirror. M_REF is diode-connected (gate tied to drain), establishing a gate voltage that M_MIR replicates to copy the reference current. 1:1 ratio. Output resistance limited by channel-length modulation.

Low Leakage.reasoning: Increased channel dimensions minimise drain-source subthreshold leakage and reduce channel-length modulation.

High Precision.reasoning: Long channel suppresses channel-length modulation (λ) mismatch; wider channels improve matching.

High Speed.reasoning: Minimum length for fastest settling; precision reduced but bandwidth maximised.

default.reasoning: Balanced sizing: adequate precision with reasonable area.

sizing_notes.M_REF: Diode-connected reference. Increasing L improves output resistance and matching.
sizing_notes.M_MIR: Mirror transistor. Must be matched to M_REF for 1:1 accuracy. Use same L and W.

kg_nodes.description: Matched transistor paths replicating bias current values.
Transistor gate tied to its drain node to create a bias reference.
Effective channel length variation under VDS fluctuation causing output current error.
